sources.name: IRS Form 990 e-file XML
sources.covers: The full return as the group filed it: totals, officers and pay, political spending (Schedule C), grants to U.S. groups (Schedule I), related groups (Schedule R).
sources.not: Donor names of 501(c)(3) and 501(c)(4) groups (the IRS public copy leaves them out). Grants to people. Money given to the group after the end of the tax year. Returns take months to arrive: most groups file 10 to 11 months after their year ends.

sources.name: GivingTuesday 990 data lake (copy of the IRS XML files on Amazon S3)
sources.covers: The same IRS XML files, one per return, unchanged. Each file is checked: the EIN inside must match.
sources.not: Newer returns appear here some weeks after the IRS releases them.

sources.name: ProPublica Nonprofit Explorer
sources.covers: A readable view of each return, built from the IRS files. Used to find which return is newest, and linked on every card.
sources.not: It is not the IRS. Its summary numbers can lag the newest return.

sources.name: IRS Tax Exempt Organization Search
sources.covers: Whether the IRS lists the group as tax-exempt, and copies of its returns and letters.
sources.not: It does not show the numbers inside a return.

meta.rule: The first set: groups already named on the Money Trail, and large politically active groups from across the spectrum, the same number from each side. Every group is read with the same rules and the same depth: the latest return we could reach, its 50 largest grants, every political organization it paid, and every officer listed.
meta.donors: Donors to 501(c)(3) and 501(c)(4) groups are not public. The IRS public copy of Schedule B leaves out donor names, so this page never names or guesses them. 527 political groups and super PACs do report donors (IRS Form 8872 and the FEC).
meta.fec_alias_note: Hand matches of a name written on a return to an FEC committee, used only when the return names the committee by a short name: NRA Political Victory Fund is the FEC committee NATIONAL RIFLE ASSOCIATION OF AMERICA POLITICAL VICTORY FUND (C00053553).
